hyps.why: Restoring a connection on edge 3 from none gives a large gain (+2.9/+6.5/+13.8), far more than replacing an existing op.
Removing a 3x3 conv from edge 3 loses more accuracy than removing a 1x1 conv (-3.8/-6.5/-17.5 vs -1.0/-3.7/-8.8).
Downgrading a 3x3 conv on edge 3 to skip is negative while other parents gain.
With a pooling edge 3 the gain from upgrading edge 0 to 3x3 shrinks to about +1.8/+1.2/+1.9.
Edge 3 being avg_pool reduces the benefit of a 3x3 conv on edge 1 (+2.0/+2.8/+3.4 vs +2.6/+4.4/+8.0).
Edge 3 being avg_pool gives a much smaller gain from a 3x3 conv on edge 4 (+0.8/+1.7/+1.4).
With edge 0 removed the 3x3 upgrade on edge 4 yields almost no gain (+0.6/-0.4/+0.8).
Replacing a 3x3 conv with pooling on edge 2 hurts (-2.5/-2.7/-6.2), unlike replacing weaker ops.
Replacing a 3x3 conv on edge 5 with skip loses accuracy (-2.7/-4.5/-8.8).
Removing a 3x3 conv on edge 0 is far more damaging (-4.0/-5.5/-10.2) than removing skip, pool or 1x1.
